author: Viajerosenamorado

title: Alhambra with Carolina
text:
The Alhambra tour with Carolina was amazing!
The Alhambra itself was magical at night but experiencing it with a guide as knowledgeable and passionate about Granadas history just made the experience so much more remarkable. I usually dislike guided tours around monuments because of how boring and long it gets. This was the complete opposite. Caroline shared so much with us and was so well informed about Muslims and their beliefs which is a huge part of the Alhambra’s history.
Carolina made the tour interactive and fun.
I would highly recommend Carolina and experiencing her love for history and
author: Mishqah_M

title: Everything is great.
text: Everything is very good; I requested the tour at the last minute because I thought it would be easier to get tickets for the Alhambra. They contacted me to inform me that they could not guarantee the tour, but they would do everything possible... Finally, they secured my ticket, and I enjoyed a very good tour!
author: nicofA3294NZ

title: Magical night tour of the Alhambra with Carolina
text:
Carolina was excellent.  She has extensive knowledge and was able to answer every question from our family of four.  She is also extremely kind and patient. 
The Alhambra was incredible , breathtaking examples of Islamic and Christian history.  We did the night tour which was lovely as the weather was cool and the night lights were magical.
author: Heather L

title: Amazing experience at the Alhambra!
text: Carolina and Sultan tours was such an amazing experience!  The night tour of the Alhambra was a magical experience and our guide was so knowledgeable, friendly, fun and accommodating.  I highly recommend this tour if you’re looking for a great time in Granada!
author: F8205VXdanielh

title: Perfect way to see the Alhambra
text: Wonderful way to see the Alhambra-the night views of the city and the way the contrast lighting makes the beautiful details pop was perfect. Our guide was amazing and really took the experience to the next level, and while there were plenty of groups it was less crowded than what we heard about the daytime tours.
author: Ryan_M

title: Wonderful, the guide very...
text: Wonderful, the very eloquent guide, told you everything super well. You can see that he likes the history of his land because he conveys it with great emotion and clarity, apart from accepting suggestion and rejoicing in complementing it with new things that he did not know. A 100.
author: Cristian_S
